thaw — theme options

Each theme: browse screen with ANALYSIS excluded (left) and the restore dialog (right). Demo data, not your bucket. Ctrl+T cycles themes live in the app.

Amber phosphor --theme amber

Monochrome amber CRT. ASCII box borders, ■ ticks, # / ~ / + status glyphs.

Green phosphor --theme phosphor

Green-screen VT terminal. Solid borders, [X] ticks, * / ~ / √ glyphs.

DOS commander --theme dos

Blue-panel DOS file manager. Double-line borders, cyan/yellow on blue.

Synthwave --theme synthwave

Outrun neon: hot pink, cyan and gold on deep purple. Heavy borders, ◆ ticks.

8-bit home computer --theme eightbit

8-bit home computer: lilac on blue, SHOUTY UPPERCASE chrome, READY. banner.

Plain (current) --theme textual-dark

No retro styling — the current look, for comparison.
